title: Among the above 30 States/UTs, Uttar Pradesh allocated the highest outlay of Rs.9288.2 lakhs in the budget for the various prisons in the State. This was followed by Tamil Nadu (Rs.4426.26 lakhs), Maharashtra (Rs.4224.41 lakhs) and Delhi (Rs.2986.8 lakhs). In Dadra & Nagar Haveli, a meagre sum of Rs.2.80 lakhs only had been provided as annual budget for the jails in the territory
